About Me

Turning ideas into fast, elegant products

I'm Mubasher Fayaz, a full-stack developer based in Bannu, Pakistan. Since 2020 I've been designing and building web software that solves everyday business problems — clean interfaces on the surface, solid systems underneath.

My recent work focuses on practical business systems: point-of-sale and inventory apps, clinic token and queue displays, lab management, sales trackers and dashboards — increasingly with AI features woven in where they genuinely save time.

I care about the details clients actually feel: pages that load instantly, flows that need no training, and code that's easy to extend when the business grows. Every project ships responsive, tested and ready to use.
